verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation service, and such a service could plausibly expose a versioned API, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents only dashboard and application workflows (incorporation, EIN, 83(b) filings, SAFEs). Nothing shows an Atlas API, API versioning, or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
